about_the_game:
Welcome to fictional Major Islands! Located in Canada, this small island chain is just a few miles out of Cherchago City. The network on the islands is not owned by any company, but by the government itself. The same applies to a coastal Bay Line in the east. As such, many different companies use these tracks to offer their services to the islands, however most of them are handled by MVR.

The island chain is located in the Major bay, at the mouth of the Johnson river. The island chain consists of 5 islands, separated into 5 operation areas. Southland, Beaver Cove, North End, Pioneer and Wenatchee. North End is too far from the rest of the islands to have a bridge connection, so all traffic is handled by a ferry. Southland has a ferry connection to the mainland in the west. Wenatchee in the east, has a bridge connection to the MVR Mainline and government Bay Line connecting to Cherchago City and New Penzance.

Included sessions:

01 - Introduction - Tutorial
02 - Eastbound Passenger - Easy
03 - Shunter´s Dream - Expert Challenge
04 - Working With Coal 1 - Normal
05 - Working With Coal 2 - Hard
06 - Shiny Silver - Easy
07 - Shunter´s Nightmare - Expert Challenge
08 - Westbound Passenger Service - Easy
09 - Evening Logs - Normal
10 - Limestone Coal - Normal
11 - Ice Cream Run - Easy
12 - Freeroam Spring, Summer, Autumn
13 - Freeroam Winter
